name: Sourcelyx Supplier Sync for WooCommerce
author: sllckylldrm

sections.description:
Sourcelyx Supplier Sync for WooCommerce helps store owners preview and apply supplier CSV price and stock updates to WooCommerce products by SKU. This is a public beta. Review the preview carefully before applying changes and test on a staging site first. Compatibility was validated in isolated environments with WordPress 6.8.3 and 7.1.2, WooCommerce 10.4.3, PHP 8.2, and MariaDB 10.11.

Features

  • Supplier CSV import with server-side validation.
  • SKU matching for simple products and variation SKUs.
  • Current/new price and stock preview with optional percentage margin.
  • Separate confirmation step before any WooCommerce product update.
  • Conflict detection when values changed after preview.
  • Batch processing with resume and cancel controls for large CSV files.
  • Import history with per-item old/new snapshots.
  • Guarded rollback for eligible successful items.
  • Streaming CSV preparation and stock-management safety.
  • Variable parent price protection.
  • No artificial plan, license, or row-count limit; actual limits depend on hosting resources and file size.

Safety

  • Products are not changed during preview.
  • A separate nonce-protected confirmation is required before apply.
  • Stale preview values are not silently overwritten.
  • Products with stock management disabled are not forced into stock management.
  • Variable parent products are not used as accidental price targets.
  • Cancelling an import does not automatically roll back completed updates.
  • Rollback checks current values and restores only eligible successful items.

Limitations

  • CSV is the only supported input format; XLSX and XML are not supported.
  • Scheduled sync, supplier APIs, automatic remote feed fetching, and background workers are not included.
  • This WordPress.org Free build is fully functional without licensing, payment, remote activation, or a quota.
  • Large imports use server-side streaming and controlled batches; browser/runtime limits still apply naturally.

Privacy and external services

Supplier CSV files are processed on the WordPress site. Import history may store operational data such as the filename, user, status, SKU, product identifier, old value, new value, result, and rollback status in the site database. The plugin does not send supplier CSV or product data to the developer’s server.

The WordPress.org Free build has no bundled licensing SDK, paid activation, telemetry, or remote service dependency. Supplier CSV files and product data remain on the WordPress site.

Security

Security reports can be sent to sellcukyilldirim@gmail.com. Do not include passwords, license keys, API keys, customer data, full production databases, or unsanitized supplier data in a report.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the sourcelyx-supplier-sync.zip package through the WordPress plugin installer.
  3. Activate Sourcelyx Supplier Sync for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Sourcelyx Supplier Sync, choose a CSV file, and review the preview.
  5. Apply changes only after reviewing the separate confirmation table.
sections.faq:
Does preview change products?

No. Preview only reads and displays matching data. Apply requires a separate explicit action.

What happens when a SKU is not found?

The row is reported as unmatched and is not used to create a product.

What happens when a product changes after preview?

The row is reported as a conflict and is not silently overwritten.

Does uninstall delete import history?

No. Uninstall is intentionally non-destructive and retains import history and user data.
sections.changelog:
0.1.4

  • Fixed public extension API apply safety so product changes made after preview are reported as conflicts instead of being silently overwritten.

0.1.3

  • Added a versioned public extension API for companion integrations without changing the CSV workflow.

0.1.2

  • Declared WooCommerce HPOS compatibility after auditing the plugin’s order-storage dependencies.
  • Confirmed product updates use WooCommerce product CRUD APIs; no order storage or cart/checkout declaration was added.

0.1.1

  • WordPress.org review remediation: distinctive branding, Free-only packaging, native upload handling, and no artificial row quota.
  • Initial public Free beta.
  • Added CSV price and stock updates by SKU without an artificial row limit.
  • Added preview before apply, variation SKU support, conflict protection, import history, and guarded rollback.
